# Message board

## Objective

Let members publish posts and discuss them through comments.

## Product decisions

- **D1 — Visibility (User):** Published posts are visible to every member.

## Visible success

- A member can publish a post and another member can comment.

## Expected refusals

- A member cannot retract another member's comment.

## Assumptions

- Member identities are supplied by the host.

## Non-goals

- Private messages.

## Open decisions

- Visual presentation remains unspecified.
